findings.description: The bucket is explicitly noted and configured to be public, allowing unauthenticated or unintended access to its contents including the customer-master.xlsx object stored in it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is present, meaning objects stored in the bucket (including sensitive customer data) are not encrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: A customer master data file is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, so objects are stored unencrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so objects stored in it are not encrypted at rest by default, risking exposure of data if underlying storage or backups are compromised.
The bucket lacks a logging block to capture access logs, removing an important audit trail for detecting unauthorized or anomalous access.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so objects stored in it are not encrypted at rest by default, exposing sensitive data science data if storage is compromised.
